The comparison is saved and complete: over 11 exactly matched elapsed sample times (0.0–142.0 h), **CHO-004-R02 ran lower in glucose than CHO-004-R01**, with a mean signed difference (CHO-004-R02 − CHO-004-R01) of **−0.239 g/L** and a largest absolute difference of **0.944 g/L at 19.5 h** (CHO-004-R01: 7.133 g/L vs CHO-004-R02: 6.189 g/L).

**Numerical summary (glucose, g/L, difference = CHO-004-R02 − CHO-004-R01)**
- Matched times: 11, from 0.0 h to 142.0 h; CHO-004-R02 was lower at 9 of them (highest values early, at 0.0 h +0.175 and 28.0 h +0.261).
- Mean difference: −0.239 g/L (median −0.242 g/L, range −0.944 to +0.261 g/L, standard deviation 0.324 g/L).
- Largest difference: −0.944 g/L at 19.5 h, i.e., CHO-004-R02 lower.
- CHO-004-R01 has one unmatched sample at 164.0 h (CHO-004-R02 ends at 142.0 h); 11 of 12 CHO-004-R01 samples matched.
- Descriptive only: successive samples of a run are not independent, so no significance test is reported, and batch context (product, process version, equipment, scale, stage) is not recorded for either batch.
